from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

        # Data from storyboard
        title = "The Hook: Meet Milly the Laser Robot"

        ]
        
        self.setup_layout(title, lecture_lines)
        
        # Colors
        STAR_COLOR = WHITE
        LASER_COLOR = TEAL
        HIGHLIGHT_COLOR = YELLOW

        # Create stars representing a field

        # L003: 1-column buffer (Col 2+), avoid Col 6 and Row F
        star_positions = ["C3", "D4", "B4", "E3", "C5", "D2", "B5"]
        stars = VGroup(*[Dot(color=STAR_COLOR, radius=0.08) for _ in star_positions])
        for star, pos in zip(stars, star_positions):
            self.place_at_grid(star, pos)
            
        # Label for Milly at pivot 1 (C3)

            run_time=2
        )

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===

            # L008: Avoid missing methods, set_points_by_ends is robust for Line

        laser.add_updater(update_laser)
        
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].animate.set_color(LASER_COLOR),
            Create(laser),
            run_time=1.5
        )
        
        # Initial clockwise rotation

        # Vector is (1, -1), angle is -45 degrees
        target_angle_1 = -45 * DEGREES
        
        self.play(
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(target_angle_1),
            run_time=3,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.wait(0.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Today, we explore how this beam moves.
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color(HIGHLIGHT_COLOR))
        
        # Highlight the hit star (L004: Indicate)
        self.play(Indicate(stars[1], color=HIGHLIGHT_COLOR, scale_factor=1.5))
        
        # Shift pivot to star 2 (D4)
        pivot_data["pos"] = stars[1].get_center()
        
        # Move label to new pivot position D4 (label at D3)
        # Using grid coordinate for movement (L003 Area-Positioning Rule)
        target_label_pos = self.grid["D3"]
        
        self.play(
            milly_label.animate.move_to(target_label_pos),
            angle_tracker.animate.set_value(target_angle_1 - 90 * DEGREES),
            run_time=4,
            rate_func=linear
        )
        self.wait(2)
